reason: 初次 M1 运行后的独立代码审计发现 conditional permutation 与 equal-n 命名需要修正，并确认高深度 sensitivity 受到非随机 target attrition 影响。

affected_decisions.value: Freedman-Lane residual permutation on rank-transformed dependency after fitting the prespecified covariates
affected_decisions.rationale: 直接置换 dependency 会破坏 dependency 与 covariates 的既有关系；条件关联检验应保留 reduced-model fitted component。

value: median and 2.5th-97.5th percentiles of replicate-wise Spearman rho
Spearman rho of the per-target expected equal-n shift with target bootstrap CI
affected_decisions.rationale: 两个 estimand 回答不同问题，必须分开命名，不能把 expected-shift rho 称作 replicate-average rho。

affected_decisions.value: association between per-target expected equal-n shift at depth 20 and dependency
affected_decisions.rationale: 初次运行代码在结果生成前已按此方式实现；结果出现后不切换 Gate 口径。replicate-wise rho distribution 同时完整报告。

affected_decisions.value: within each context, freeze targets with at least 100 perturbed cells and reuse that identical target set at depths 20, 25, 50 and 100; 1000 repeats per depth
affected_decisions.rationale: 把 sampling-depth 变化与随 threshold 改变的非随机 target attrition 分离。

affected_decisions.value: standardized OLS with HC3 robust uncertainty for raw or noise-corrected shift as outcome and dependency plus log target-cell count as predictors
affected_decisions.rationale: 补充冻结计划承诺的简洁线性 sensitivity，不扩展为高维 covariate model。

affected_decisions.value: hash raw MTX, barcode, feature, protospacer-call, primary DepMap endpoint, frozen registry and amendments
affected_decisions.rationale: M1 equal-n 与 matched-null 直接依赖 raw cell-level inputs，run manifest 必须直接记录这些输入。

results_status_at_amendment: Initial M1 outputs had been generated and inspected; the dual-context Gate decision was STOP_AND_REASSESS.
outcome_awareness_statement: 这些修改用于修正条件置换、消除口径歧义和分离 target attrition；不依据哪个版本产生更有利的 bridge effect 选择分析。原始输出及 v1.0 registry 保留。
